_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Request for Serial Number Assignment for MARK and MOD Nomenclatured Equipment
summary: Requests assignment of serial numbers for MARK and MOD nomenclatured equipment receiving identification plates and delivered under a production contract; not assigned to experimental or developmental items.
description_purpose: The complete data provides the means to request serial numbers for each MARK and MOD nomenclatured equipment to which an identification plate is to be applied. Serial numbers are assigned to each MARK and MOD nomenclatured system and equipment delivered under a production contract. Serial numbers are not assigned to experimental or developmental items.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
Requests for assignment of serial numbers shall be submitted to Commanding Officer, Naval Ordnance Station, Indian Head, MD., 20640-5000, Code 3710P.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including approval dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The serial number assignment request shall include the following information:

children.title: Officially assigned nomenclature of the item.
children.content: This is the name and MARK and MOD type designation obtained in accordance with MIL-STD-1661(OS).

children.title: Contractor and Government Entity (CAGE) code and Top drawing or arrangement drawing number.
Exact quantity of items to be delivered under the contract.
The activity, office code or department and point of contact with phone number of originator submitting the request.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Requests for assignment of serial numbers shall be in contractor's own format.
